Country.evidence_source: In a recent study of suicide among men in Ghana, loss of economic control was reported to create a sense of abandonment (Andoh-Arthur, Knizek, Osafo, & Hjelmeland, 2018). In the present study, however, only women expressed abandonment as a reason for their suicide attempt and this was predominantly related to difficulties in romantic relationships. In Ghana, where many women are economically dependent on men, disappointment from their male partners is likely to affect not only their self-esteem but their financial survival and result in serious consequences such as suicide:
